name: capysort
description: Organize your Mac's Photos library, folders, Messages and apps by asking your assistant. Capysort does the work on your Mac; the assistant proposes changes and you approve each one in the app.

interface.longDescription: Capysort finds similar shots and duplicates, sorts screenshots, and tidies folders, Messages and apps on your Mac. ChatGPT reads a summary of what Capysort found and proposes changes; nothing changes until you approve it in Capysort, and everything can be undone. The Hidden album is never read, and message text never leaves the Mac.
defaultPrompt: Use Capysort to find duplicate photos I can clear out.
Use Capysort to sort my screenshots and file a plan for me to approve.
